overview.description: The VanEck BNB ETF Common Shares Of Beneficial Interest (VBNB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long bnb, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the price of BNB by holding the digital asset and valuing its shares using the MarketVectorTM BNB Benchmark Rate. VBNB was launched on May 7, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.

data.title: VanEck Launches First U.S. Spot BNB ETF: VBNB
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--VanEck launches VanEck BNB ETF (VBNB), the first exchange-traded product in the U.S. designed to provide spot exposure to the price movements of BNB.
